verdict.rationale: Visa documents a dedicated free sandbox with a self-serve signup process, separate test endpoints (apitest.visaacceptance.com vs api.visaacceptance.com), and explicit statements that test transactions can be sent after registration without touching production, plus free-in-sandbox fee terms. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation that sandbox fully mirrors production behavior and any detail on data isolation guarantees beyond the docs' own claims.
